description: Validation rules derived from empirical pilot runs. Each rule specifies what to check, how to check it, and what failure it prevents.

rules.name: required_using_directive_present
rules.description: All REQUIRED: using directives in per_type_constraints must appear in generated code.

implementation.logic: For each required constraint containing 'using ', verify that the full using statement appears in the generated code.

rules.name: forbidden_namespace_absent
rules.description: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources must NOT appear in generated code.

implementation.logic: Scan generated code for 'LowCode.DataSources'; fail if present.

rules.name: abstract_options_not_instantiated
rules.description: FORBIDDEN: new PluginOptions() must NOT appear in generated code. PluginOptions is abstract.

implementation.logic: Scan for 'new PluginOptions()'; fail if present.

rules.name: text_absorber_not_used
rules.description: FORBIDDEN: TextAbsorber must NOT be used. It is a core API substitution for the LowCode TextExtractor.

rules.name: concrete_options_class_used_pdfa
rules.description: REQUIRED: PdfAConvertOptions must appear in generated code for PdfAConverter.

implementation.logic: Check that 'PdfAConvertOptions' appears in generated code; fail if absent.

rules.name: wrong_generic_options_absent_pdfa
rules.description: FORBIDDEN: LowCodeLoadOptions and LowCodeSaveOptions must NOT appear in PdfAConverter code.

implementation.logic: Check for 'LowCodeLoadOptions' and 'LowCodeSaveOptions'; fail if either present.

rules.name: add_input_call_present
rules.description: REQUIRED: AddInput( call must be present in options setup. Missing AddInput means no input file will be processed.

implementation.logic: Check that 'AddInput(' appears in generated code; fail if absent.

rules.name: add_output_call_present_non_extractor
rules.description: REQUIRED: AddOutput( call must be present for all PDF types except TextExtractor.

implementation.logic: Check that 'AddOutput(' appears in generated code; fail if absent. NOT applied to TextExtractor (which has no output file).

rules.name: add_output_absent_text_extractor
rules.description: FORBIDDEN: AddOutput( must NOT be called for TextExtractor — it has no output file; read StringResult instead.

implementation.logic: Check that 'AddOutput(' does NOT appear in TextExtractor code; fail if present.

rules.name: catalog_api_hash_matches_denominator
rules.description: The api_catalog_sha256 in the denominator file must match the current run's catalog hash. Prevents stale-catalog generation.

implementation.logic: Compute SHA-256 of current api-catalog.json; compare to denominator api_catalog_sha256; fail if mismatch.

rules.name: lowcode_api_not_substituted_by_core
rules.description: Every generated example must contain at least one call to the primary LowCode type. A core API substitution (e.g., Document.Save instead of Converter.Convert) must be rejected.

implementation.logic: Extract the type_short_name from the packet; verify that the generated code contains a call to that type (new TypeName() or TypeName.Method()). Fail if absent.

rules.current_status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — planned in Gap 2 (Design 2 in plan)

rules.name: processor_constructors_check
rules.description: Before adding any type to allowed_types, verify constructors array is not empty and at least one static method exists (or the API is an instance type with public constructors).

implementation.logic: For each type in allowed_types: if constructors:[] AND no is_static:true methods → raise PermanentBlocker('API_ACCESS_PARADOX'). Log to backlog, skip type.

rules.current_status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — manual check performed for Processor; automated check pending

validation_gaps.description: VR-001, VR-005, VR-006, VR-007, VR-008, VR-009 are only active for PDF. Need generalization to all families using per_type_constraints config.
VR-011 (LowCode call presence check) is not implemented. Core API substitutions can pass build+runtime undetected for non-PDF families.
VR-012 (API access paradox pre-check) is not implemented. New types with constructors:[] can be added to allowed_types and will fail at build time.
